harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Configured node1 (OpenWrt) as a router between lan-a (node2, eth1/10.10.9.0/24) and lan-b (node3, eth2/10.10.8.0/24). Created UCI firewall zones 'lana' and 'lanb' with default forward=REJECT, plus a single rule permitting only TCP/5432 from lana to lanb; all other cross-network traffic (other ports, ICMP, and the reverse direction) is rejected. Assigned static addressing on node2/node3 via dedicated systemd-networkd .network files (higher-priority match than the existing DHCP=yes catch-all) with static routes to the peer subnet via node1. Verified the policy end-to-end (node2->node3:5432 succeeds, node2->node3 other port/ICMP fails, node3->node2:5432 fails), then completed the mandatory one-at-a-time restart protocol on node1, node2, and node3, proving changed boot IDs and full recovery of interfaces, routes, firewall ruleset, and the TCP/5432-only policy after each reboot.
actions_performed: Inspected node1/node2/node3 baseline network config, existing single 10.100.186.0/24 management network
Identified node1's unconfigured eth1/eth2 and node2/node3's unconfigured enp8s0 as the lan-a/lan-b link NICs via IP-assignment probing
Confirmed eth1<->node2 and eth2<->node3 mapping via targeted ping tests
Configured static UCI network interfaces 'lana' (eth1, 10.10.9.1/24) and 'lanb' (eth2, 10.10.8.1/24) on node1

Created systemd-networkd override files 10-enp8s0.network on node2 (10.10.9.11/24, route to 10.10.8.0/24) and node3 (10.10.8.12/24, route to 10.10.9.0/24) to take precedence over the existing DHCP=yes catch-all
Restarted systemd-networkd on node2/node3 and verified addressing/routes persisted
Configured UCI firewall zones 'lana' and 'lanb' (forward=REJECT) and one rule 'Allow-LanA-LanB-Postgres' (src=lana dest=lanb proto=tcp dest_port=5432 target=ACCEPT), committed and reloaded firewall
Verified via nft ruleset dump that forward_lana only accepts tcp/5432 to lanb (else reject) and forward_lanb rejects everything
Ran functional tests: node2->node3:5432 TCP succeeds, node2->node3 ICMP and other TCP ports fail, node3->node2:5432 fails
Captured pre-restart boot_id/uptime baseline and healthy-state evidence on all three nodes
Rebooted node1, polled until exec recovered, verified changed boot_id and full recovery of interface IPs, ip_forward, uci changes (clean), and firewall ruleset
Rebooted node2, polled until exec recovered, verified changed boot_id and persisted static IP/route
Rebooted node3, polled until exec recovered, verified changed boot_id and persisted static IP/route
Re-ran full policy validation (allowed port, blocked port, blocked reverse direction) after all three nodes were rebooted
Cleaned up temporary nc listeners used for testing

evidence.requirement: node2 (lan-a) can reach node3 (lan-b) on TCP 5432
evidence.summary: nc listener on node3:5432 accepts data sent from node2 both before and after the node restarts (allowed_exit=0)

evidence.requirement: All other node2->node3 traffic is refused
evidence.summary: ICMP ping and TCP to port 9999/6000 from node2 to node3 fail (ping_exit=1, other_port_exit=1) both pre- and post-restart

evidence.requirement: Reverse direction (node3->node2), including port 5432, is refused
evidence.summary: TCP connection attempt from node3 to node2:5432 fails (exit=1) both pre- and post-restart, confirming only lana->lanb:5432 is permitted

evidence.requirement: Firewall/topology configuration correctly implements the permit/refuse policy
evidence.summary: UCI firewall zones lana/lanb (forward=REJECT) plus one rule permitting tcp/5432 lana->lanb committed; nft ruleset dump shows forward_lana only accepts tcp dport 5432 (else reject) and forward_lanb rejects all, confirmed again after node1 reboot

evidence.requirement: Static addressing/routes for lan-a/lan-b persist across reboot
evidence.summary: node1 eth1/eth2 static IPs and node2/node3 enp8s0 static IPs plus cross-subnet static routes present before and after each node's restart

evidence.requirement: node1 restart: healthy baseline, restart, changed boot identity, recovered state
evidence.summary: boot_id 850db1df...->d7eb3b20... after reboot; ip_forward, interfaces, uci changes, and nft ruleset all confirmed recovered post-restart

evidence.requirement: node2 restart: healthy baseline, restart, changed boot identity, recovered state
evidence.summary: boot_id 242af11e...->d2f2ee70... after reboot; static IP/route on enp8s0 confirmed recovered

evidence.requirement: node3 restart: healthy baseline, restart, changed boot identity, recovered state
evidence.summary: boot_id 92ec88af...->cf42308a... after reboot; static IP/route on enp8s0 confirmed recovered
